OP-01.title: OP-01 Romance Dawn Booster Box Price & Reprint (Japanese)
OP-01.description: Track the Japanese OP-01 Romance Dawn booster box price, documented reprint record, factory-seal checks and top chase cards with dated market data.
OP-01.heading: OP-01 booster box price, reprint record and seal checks
OP-01.marketContext: As the first main One Piece Card Game set, OP-01 attracts set-run collectors as well as buyers focused on its Luffy, Zoro and Law parallels. Compare the tracked market value with the current asking-price sample rather than treating one listing as the market.
OP-01.reprintContext: No dated retailer or distributor reprint is currently recorded in our source ledger. That means no source-backed entry is on file; it is not proof that no additional OP-01 stock ever reached stores.
OP-01.sealContext: For an older Japanese OP-01 display, require clear photos of the original Bandai security tape in uncut condition, both side seams, the bottom and the product code. Added shrink alone is not factory-seal evidence.

OP-05.title: OP-05 Awakening of the New Era Box Price & Reprint
OP-05.description: Check the Japanese OP-05 booster box price, documented reprint status, Bandai tape checks and top Gear 5 chase cards using dated market observations.
OP-05.heading: OP-05 box price, reprint status and Bandai tape checks
OP-05.marketContext: OP-05 demand is unusually concentrated around its Gear 5 and signed Luffy treatments, so sealed-box asks can move faster than the rest of the set. The dated market series and top-10 table should be read together.
OP-05.reprintContext: Our current source ledger has no dated OP-05 retailer or distributor reprint entry. Restock rumours and marketplace inventory are not labelled as a reprint unless a traceable source supports the claim.
OP-05.sealContext: High demand makes seal photos especially important: verify the original Bandai security tape is present and uncut, then inspect the side flaps, bottom and product code. Extra shrink does not replace the tape check.

PRB-01.title: PRB-01 Premium Booster Box Price & Reprint (Japanese)
PRB-01.description: Track the Japanese PRB-01 Premium Booster box price, confirmed reprint evidence, 10-pack box format, factory tape and distributed chase-card demand.
PRB-01.heading: PRB-01 box price, reprint evidence and factory seal
PRB-01.marketContext: PRB-01 is a 10-pack premium reprint product rather than a 24-pack main booster. Its chase demand is spread across stamped versions of established characters, so comparisons should use PRB-01 listings only and should not mix in the original printings.
PRB-01.reprintContext: The source ledger contains a MediaWorld reprint listing, but the page does not provide a distinct restock date or print quantity. It confirms a documented reprint record, not the scale of supply or a future reprint schedule.
PRB-01.sealContext: A Japanese PRB-01 box should retain its original Bandai security tape uncut. Confirm the 10-pack product format, top tape, side seams, bottom and product code; exclude loose packs and mixed PRB-01 lots.

EB-03.title: EB-03 Heroine's Edition Box Price & Reprint (Japanese)
EB-03.description: Check the Japanese EB-03 Heroine's Edition booster box price, reprint record, original Bandai tape and Robin, Nami and Hancock chase-card demand.
EB-03.heading: EB-03 box price, reprint record and original Bandai tape
EB-03.marketContext: EB-03 is driven by character collectors around Robin, Nami and Boa Hancock rather than by a conventional main-set chase mix. Because the tracking window is still young, dated sold and listing observations matter more than an isolated launch price.
EB-03.reprintContext: No dated EB-03 reprint entry is currently present in the source ledger. The product is still relatively recent, so the absence of a record must not be read as evidence that its print cycle has ended.
EB-03.sealContext: For a Japanese EB-03 display, prioritize an uncut original Bandai security tape and photos of both side seams, the base and product code. Do not treat seller-added shrink as a substitute for the factory tape.

OP-13.title: OP-13 Carrying on His Will Box Price & Reprint (Japanese)
OP-13.description: Track the Japanese OP-13 Carrying on His Will booster box price, 2025 reprint records, Bandai tape condition and its highest-demand chase cards.
OP-13.heading: OP-13 box price, 2025 reprints and factory-seal checks
OP-13.marketContext: OP-13 combines a Five Elders parallel, an Ace wanted-poster treatment and a separately tracked red manga Luffy. Variant matching matters here because standard and red manga listings cannot be combined into one chase-card price.
OP-13.reprintContext: The source ledger records retailer reprint activity in September and November 2025. Those dated records show that additional retail availability occurred, but they do not disclose print volume or establish a future restock schedule.
OP-13.sealContext: Verify that the original Bandai security tape is uncut and that photos show the tape edges, side seams, bottom and product code. OP-13 loose packs, mixed-language lots and listings that hide the seal area are excluded from sealed-box comparisons.
